name.en: 6th RCEP Ministers' Meeting (expected, with ASEAN 2027 chair Singapore)
name.zh: 第6屆RCEP部長會議（預期由2027東協主席國新加坡主辦）

title.en: Accession groups set for four applicants
title.zh: 四個申請方成立入會工作小組

summary.en: RCEP ministers agreed to set up accession working groups for Bangladesh, Chile, Hong Kong and Sri Lanka, and noted Uruguay's interest.
summary.zh: RCEP部長同意為孟加拉、智利、香港與斯里蘭卡成立入會工作小組，並注意到烏拉圭的加入意願。

question.en: Why would Chile or Uruguay, far from Asia, want to join an Asian trade deal?
question.zh: 遠在南美的智利、烏拉圭為何想加入亞洲貿易協定？

summary.en: At their September 2026 meeting in Manila, ministers moved toward a 2027 general review that may add digital economy and green rules.
summary.zh: 2026年9月馬尼拉部長會議推動2027年全面檢討，未來可能納入數位經濟與綠色轉型規則。

question.en: What new trade rules would matter most for Taiwan's exporters if Taiwan is outside RCEP?
question.zh: 台灣不在RCEP內，哪些新規則對台灣出口商影響最大？

text.en: RCEP negotiations launched in Phnom Penh
First RCEP leaders' meeting in Manila
text.zh: 於馬尼拉舉行首次RCEP領袖會議

text.en: RCEP enters into force on 1 January
Enters into force for all 15 parties (Philippines last)
text.zh: 對全部15國生效（菲律賓最後）

text.en: 5th RCEP Leaders' Summit in Kuala Lumpur
text.zh: 於吉隆坡舉行第5屆RCEP領袖峰會

text.en: Accession working groups for four applicants agreed
text.zh: 同意為四個申請方成立入會工作小組
